extracted.intended_audience: Institutional Signing Officials (SO), Program Directors/Principal Investigators (PD/PI), Grants Management Officers, institutional grants administrators and other eRA Commons users
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures and validation rules for creating, editing, routing, submitting, viewing and deleting a Relinquishing Statement (RS) in NIH eRA Commons as part of a change-of-institution (grant transfer) request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fields for Relinquishing Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: The required fields are noted by an asterisk. The following fields are required: New Institution Name, Contact Email at the Institution, Requested Termination Date (MMDDYYYY), and Direct Cost $.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure these fields are completed before saving or submitting; missing required fields produce specific error messages (e.g., 'New Institution Name is a required field.', 'Please enter data in the Email Address field (e.g. user_name@domain_name.com) (ID: 30102)', 'Termination Date is a required field. (ID: 200241)', 'Direct Cost is a required field.').

rubrics_metrics.name: New Institution selection and registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Click Search in the New Institution Name section to find the receiving institution in the eRA Commons database; if found, select its IPF Code to pre-populate DUNS and IPF code. If not found, insert the institution name manually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer choosing a newly-registered institution from search results because DUNS and IPF code are pre-populated. If the receiving institution is not registered in eRA Commons (no IPF), it may not be able to view the RS until it registers and the New Institution contacts the eRA Help Desk to link the RS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting requirement for Contact Email
rubrics_metrics.description: The email address should be in the following format: user_name@domain_name.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the email address format is invalid or not entered, an error message is produced. Enter a valid contact email to proceed; this address receives notifications (e.g., initial RS submission notification).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requested Termination Date validation
rubrics_metrics.description: The Requested Termination Date must be entered in MMDDYYYY format and must be within the current budget period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If Termination Date is missing or outside the current budget period, the system shows errors: 'Termination Date is a required field.' or 'The requested Termination Date must be within the current budget period.' Ensure dates align with the award's budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct/Indirect/Total cost numeric and upper bound limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct Cost, Indirect Cost, and Total Cost fields must be numeric and cannot exceed 999,999,999.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If any cost exceeds 999,999,999 the system displays: 'Direct Cost amount cannot exceed 999,999,999.' / 'Indirect Cost amount cannot exceed 999,999,999.' / 'Total Cost amount cannot exceed 999,999,999.' Ensure values are realistic and within these limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost amount constraints relative to current budget period
rubrics_metrics.description: For transfers of active awards, the direct costs being relinquished must not exceed the direct costs for the current budget period; the indirect costs being relinquished must not exceed the direct costs for the current budget period; and the total costs being relinquished must not exceed the costs for the current budget period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The system enforces these checks and returns explicit errors if violated (e.g., 'The direct costs being relinquished must not exceed the direct costs for the current budget period for transfers of active awards.'). Verify award amounts and compute unexpended balances correctly before entering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment transfer entry convention
rubrics_metrics.description: If there is no equipment to be transferred, type 'NONE' in the Equipment Transferring with the Project section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the literal 'NONE' when applicable to indicate no equipment transfer.

rubrics_metrics.name: When a new RS can (or cannot) be started
rubrics_metrics.description: To start a new RS click 'Start a new RS'. If an RS has already been submitted, a new RS cannot be submitted unless the prior RS(s) shows a status of 'Accepted for Consideration' or 'Refused'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check existing RS statuses in Manage Relinquishing Statement before attempting to create a new RS to avoid blocked submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing constraints for RS
rubrics_metrics.description: To edit an RS, the RS’s status must be SO Work in Progress (WIP) or Returned. When routed to PD/PI, PD/PI may edit only the institution information and contact email address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Edit link only when allowed by status; otherwise editing is disabled. Save or Cancel while editing; Save sets status to SO Work in Progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleting a Relinquishing Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: An RS may be deleted only if it is in SO Work in Progress state and has never been submitted to the Agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delete via the Delete link on Manage Relinquishing Statement; a confirmation screen appears where you must confirm Delete. If canceled, operation is aborted. Deletion removes all data associated with the RS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may submit an RS to NIH
rubrics_metrics.description: Only an institution's Signing Official (SO) can submit a Relinquishing Statement to the Agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When submitting, the institution name and contact information must be provided. Clicking Submit displays the Applicant Organization Certification and Acceptance statement; the SO must click 'I Agree' to complete submission. If Cancel is clicked, RS will not be submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification and acceptance requirement at submission
rubrics_metrics.description: At submission the Applicant Organization Certification and Acceptance statement is presented; it affirms termination willingness, relinquishment of unexpended funds, obligation to comply with PHS terms and conditions, and acknowledges potential penalties for false statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SO must affirm ('I Agree') for the RS to be submitted. Canceling will prevent submission. The system confirms submission and generates RS PDF; generation may take 30 seconds to 2 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Routing actions and next reviewer selection
rubrics_metrics.description: SOs can route the RS to PD/PI (Route to PI button) and PD/PI can route it back to SO (Route to SO button). The Route screen displays 'Next Reviewer' and allows entering optional comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When routing back to SO, if multiple SOs exist, use the Next Reviewer dropdown to select the appropriate SO (names displayed last name, first name). If New Institution Name or IPF is missing when routing, the system will display warnings and may prevent routing.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPF/DUNS requirement for linking and visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The IPF Code is used to link the submitted RS to the receiving institution and to make it viewable for SO at the receiving institution; if IPF is not provided because institution not registered, the New Institution may not receive notification and will not be able to view the RS until they register and contact the helpdesk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer selecting the institution from eRA Commons search results (pre-populates IPF/DUNS). If inserting an unregistered institution, advise them to register and contact eRA Help Desk to link the RS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status values and routing history entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Routing history may display statuses such as: SO Work in Progress, PD/PI Work in Progress, Submitted to Agency, Returned, Accepted for Consideration, Submitted to Agency and Linked, or Accepted for Consideration and Linked.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: View routing history via the View Routing History link to understand where the RS is in processing. Use status to determine available actions (edit, route, view).

rubrics_metrics.name: Email notifications associated with RS events
rubrics_metrics.description: A variety of pre-defined emails are sent on RS events (e.g., submission, acknowledgement, route-to-reviewer, return-by-NIH, linked to new institution, timed reminders). Recipients vary: new institution contact, PD/PI, SO, centralized institution mailbox, GMS/PO/DRR/SRO depending on application stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emails include content instructing recipients how to view the RS in Commons, next steps (e.g., change of institution application), and helpdesk contact info. Review email types (Submit confirmation, Routed notification, Returned by NIH, Acknowledgement, Visibility notification, 30-day reminders) to know expected communications and recipients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Institution time-based reminders
rubrics_metrics.description: Automated reminder emails are sent at time-based intervals (examples: 30 days after RS submit date to the new institution contact reminding to submit change-of-institution application; 30 days after change-of-institution application submit date to former institution SO/central mailbox/PD/PI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reminders warn that failure to provide timely documentation may result in disapproval or delays and include helpdesk contact info; recipients who have already submitted may disregard the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Behavior when award is in no-cost extension or near project end
rubrics_metrics.description: If the award is in a no-cost extension or within three months of the project period end date, an informational pop-up appears noting that NIH IC policies may limit change-of-grantee requests and instructing contact with awarding IC to determine policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click OK to proceed; but contact awarding IC because IC policy may limit ability to change institution when little time remains on award.

rubrics_metrics.name: System error and search-related error messages
rubrics_metrics.description: The user may see system-produced errors when unexpected conditions or missing inputs occur: 'An unexpected error occurred. Please contact eRA Help Desk.'; 'You must enter the following required fields to proceed<field>.'; 'No grants to relinquish have been found.'; 'Document Not Found' when RS PDF missing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow instructions in messages (re-enter required fields, contact eRA Help Desk) and use provided helpdesk contact methods if errors persist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing RS and associated PDF availability
rubrics_metrics.description: If the RS has not been submitted to NIH, viewing displays a non-editable Relinquishing Statement screen. If RS has been submitted to NIH, the system displays the RS as a PDF in a separate window. If the PDF file does not exist, 'Document Not Found' is shown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the View link to inspect RS; allow time for PDF generation after submission (the system may show an informational message while creating the PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: FFR (Federal Financial Report) submission requirement via eRA Commons
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH requires all financial expenditure data (FFRs) to be submitted via eRA Commons; the FFR is a statement of expenditures associated with a grant and is used to report the status of funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users with the FSR role can Create, View, Submit, and Revise FFRs and can access the FFR module from Closeout Status. If revising a previously submitted FSR, submit using the FSR format; eRA Commons will automatically select the correct form for the user. Refer to FFR help topics or the FFR Expenditure Data User Guide PDF for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Conflict of Interest (FCOI) reporting responsibilities and roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutions must report identified Financial Conflicts of Interest as required by 42 CFR Part 50 Subpart F. The institution’s Signing Official (SO) completes FCOI reporting unless the FCOI role is delegated; the SO can assign FCOI_ASST and FCOI_View roles to other users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the FCOI module within eRA Commons to manage reporting. Refer to the Office of Extramural Research FCOI FAQs and the FCOI External User Guide for full regulatory and procedural details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference letter submission constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference letters must be submitted using eRA Commons any time after the FOA is posted and no later than the deadline. The Referee does not need a Commons role, but the candidate must have a Commons account holding the PI role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the candidate does not hold the PI role, the referee will receive error 'Commons User ID of Applicant entered is invalid (ID:90274)'. The candidate’s SO or Accounts Administrator must assign the PI role to avoid this error.
